newsitem.title: JAPAN: Typhoon halts loading at two Okinawa refiners.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon halts loading at two Okinawa refiners.

text.p: Loading and discharge of crude and petroleum products was halted at two Okinawa refineries overnight due to a typhoon, refinery sources said on Friday.
But refining operations at the plants have not been affected, officials said.
The facilities involved include a 100,000 barrel per day (bpd) plant belonging to Nansei Sekiyu KK and a 110,000 bpd plant belonging to Okinawa Sekiyu Seisei.

Loading and discharge would likely not resume for the rest of the day, an Okinawa refinery official said, adding that the plant had sufficient tank space for products and that crude delivery is not scheduled until next month.
Typhoon Peter, upgraded by forecaster Weather Services Corp from a tropical storm overnight, is expected in Kyushu in 20-26 hours.
